program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (cell< a b) (or (< (first a) (first b)) (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)))))
    (define (line-ok? line)
      (and (all? (lambda (p) (member? (at g (first p) (second p)) (list 0 2))) line)
           (= 2 (count-where (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 2)) line))))
    (let* ((pts (find-color g 2))
           (pairs (for*/list ([a pts] [b pts] #:when (cell< a b)) (list a b))))
      (foldl
        (lambda (pair out)
          (let* ((a (first pair))
                 (b (second pair))
                 (ar (first a)) (ac (second a)) (br (first b)) (bc (second b)))
            (cond
              [(= ar br)
               (let* ((c0 (min ac bc)) (c1 (max ac bc))
                      (line (for/list ([c (range c0 (+ c1 1))]) (list ar c)))
                      (interior (for/list ([c (range (+ c0 1) c1)]) (list ar c))))
                 (if (line-ok? line) (paint-cells out interior 8) out))]
              [(= ac bc)
               (let* ((r0 (min ar br)) (r1 (max ar br))
                      (line (for/list ([r (range r0 (+ r1 1))]) (list r ac)))
                      (interior (for/list ([r (range (+ r0 1) r1)]) (list r ac))))
                 (if (line-ok? line) (paint-cells out interior 8) out))]
              [else out])))
        g
        pairs))))
